verdict.rationale: PostHog documents personal API keys that are scoped by construction: per-resource scopes, project-level access limits, individual revocation and admin auditing with last-used timestamps. Its CLI docs tell users to create agent keys with only the scopes a command needs, and it offers OAuth for delegated scoped access. A live probe confirms the OAuth-gated MCP server publishes 150 granular read/write scopes, and per-session MCP tool scoping adds a further least-privilege layer. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on corroboration of scoped-key use for agents.
